description: Adds, points and removes the developer's domains and forwards their mail; register and transfer answer a link to approve in the panel. More: neblla_get_llms tools/domains

accept.description: copy: go on despite the differences (the developer said so)

action.description: By action: add {domain}; copy {domain}; remove {domain}; point_web {domain, appId, confirm?}; unpoint_web {domain}; transfer {domain}; register {domain, autoRenew?}; mail_forward {domain, to, from?}; mail_stop {domain, from?}

appId.description: point_web: the app the web shows

autoRenew.description: register: renew the domain by itself every year (default false)

confirm.description: point_web only: true applies the change to the web records.

from.description: mail_forward / mail_stop: "*" or an address of the domain

replaceMailboxes.description: mail_forward: true replaces the other provider's mailboxes
